name: mailbox
description: Send and read direct 1:1 messages with another named agent (letters and replies), backed by an append-only shared thread file.

reply_to.description: Optional id of the message this is replying to — keeps the reply attached to the original letter in the same thread (used with action='send').

with.description: The other agent id in the thread to read (used with action='read'). Omit to read every thread I'm a party to.

limit.description: Max number of most-recent messages to return for action='read'.
